user.title: Data sources
user.description: This version plans and simulates; it sends no device commands. The forecast sensor supplies quarter-hour PV and load. Import and export prices can be selected independently next. Optional power sensors are mappings only.

battery.title: Battery and planning assumptions
battery.description: Values are assumptions, not manufacturer approval. The final SOC is at least the initial SOC. A smaller step increases precision and computation time. Do not count the same investment twice as wear and capital cost.

data.wear_cost_eur_per_kwh: Additional wear per discharged AC kWh (EUR)
data.allow_grid_charge: Allow grid charging in the simulation
data.allow_battery_export: Allow battery export in the simulation

prices.title: Select price sources
prices.description: Import and export are separate tariffs. Existing forecast prices remain the default. SMARD is an experimental DE/LU data adapter, not a complete retail tariff; check availability and terms of use.

price_details.title: Prices and tariff components
price_details.description: Final price = converted source price × multiplier + adder in EUR/kWh. For complete prices use multiplier 1 and adder 0. Examples: 100 EUR/MWh = 0.10 EUR/kWh; 10 ct/kWh = 0.10 EUR/kWh. URL and entity sources need prices rows with start, duration_hours or end, and value; no HTML pages or credentials. Missing values are not filled.

data.import_price_url: Import: JSON API URL (not a web page)
data.import_fixed_price: Import: fixed price in selected unit
data.export_price_url: Export: JSON API URL (not a web page)
data.export_fixed_price: Export: fixed price in selected unit

error.invalid_battery: Check SOC limits, power, efficiencies and calculation step.
error.invalid_prices: Check price source, unit, address and numbers.
